data.description: You augment an ongoing illusion effect to strike out painfully at creatures that see through it. When a creature successfully disbelieves an illusion that is the target of painful revelation, it takes min(10,CASTERLEVEL/2)d6 points of nonlethal damage and is staggered for 1d4 rounds. A successful Will save reduces the nonlethal damage by half and negates the staggered effect. Once painful revelation has been triggered, the spell ends. However, creatures under the effect of spells such as true seeing that automatically pierce illusions are not subject to this effect.
